notes: Patient-financing export rules for the finance/rcm/dental pack (Phase 4a.2, DESIGN/xrplh-25 §13; Phase 4c, xrplh-26: items verified from the owner's anonymized real-format rows where the rows prove them). Layouts (header signatures) are in code; every rule here is an item { value, verified, basis }. An unverified item makes each loaded file fail its 'rules verified' check, so the report shows it as UNVERIFIED. Unknown Type values and ambiguous or unparseable dates fail checks; nothing is guessed.

dateFormats.basis: owner sample GLOBAL-CareCredit-sample-fin-csv.csv (Phase 4c, 2026-11-03): 3/3 rows are "MM/DD/YYYY h:mm AM|PM ET" (e.g. 02/24/2025 2:24 PM ET); the date part is used
